translations.translatedText: # Friday 10.3.2017 (radio)

People are seeking help from municipal social welfare offices because of the Kela backlog. Many flights have been cancelled. You can also see a doctor at a remote appointment. Bridges are being examined again. Next week the weather will be spring-like.
## Hardship is driving people to the social welfare office
![A woman and a pram are reflected in the window of a Kela office.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-9490471)
Open image viewer
At least Helsinki, Espoo and Vantaa have had to help people who are in hardship. Photo: Antti Aimo-Koivisto / Lehtikuva
Many people are now seeking help from the municipal social welfare office. They need basic social assistance. In the capital region the municipalities have given help for essential expenses.
The reason is the Kela backlog and applications that have been rejected. Kela has rejected a quarter of new applications.

Municipal social workers try to handle emergencies, and they negotiate with Kela. If you cannot get help from Kela, municipalities can grant support at their discretion. If, for example, there is no food in the fridge, a person can get a payment commitment for a shop or food money to their account.
Now Kela has also started to give urgent help.
## Many flights have been cancelled
![Helsinki-Vantaa Airport.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-9503290)
Open image viewer
The industrial action started at 15 and ended at 19. Photo: Antti Aimo-koivisto / Lehtikuva

The Aviation Union's work stoppage has disrupted baggage handling and security checks at Helsinki-Vantaa Airport. The stoppage lasted 4 hours. Finnair has cancelled over 100 flights on Friday because of the strike.
There will be another attempt to mediate the labour dispute on Monday. National Conciliator Minna Helle says that an agreement is far away.
Because of the strike, the railway company VR is adding sleeping cars to trains between Helsinki and Rovaniemi at the weekend.
## You meet a remote doctor online
![A chat conversation and a photo of an eye on a phone screen.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-9491045)
Open image viewer
At a remote visit the doctor judges whether the patient needs a physical examination. Photo: Tiina Jutila / Yle
You can also meet a doctor online. The patient and the doctor exchange messages or pictures in chat messages.
Online the patient gets help in treating familiar illnesses when the illness does not require a physical examination. These include, for example, eye infections and allergies and monitoring diabetes.
Many big private medical companies are adding remote appointments.  A remote appointment is cheaper than going to the doctor. You also get Kela reimbursement for it.
## Bridges are being examined again
![The Takamäki junction bridge on Seinäjoki's eastern bypass.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-9383108)
Open image viewer
The Takamäki junction bridge on Seinäjoki's eastern bypass. Photo: Pasi Takkunen / Yle
The Finnish Transport Agency is continuing strength tests on bridges. 93 bridges are being examined in different parts of Finland.
The bridges were built between 2005 and 2016. Some of them are road bridges and some are railway bridges.
In autumn it was noticed on construction sites that the concrete was not strong enough. The Transport Agency said in January that a defect has been found in a bridge.
## Next week is spring-like
![forecast graphic](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-9502425)
Open image viewer
Photo: Yle
The weather will get warmer next week.
At the start of the week it may be 3 or even 5 degrees above zero. At the end of the week it may be 8 degrees above zero. In the north it is below zero even during the day.
![forecast graphic](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-9502427)
Open image viewer
Photo: Yle
Yle meteorologist Matti Huutonen says that cloudiness will decide the temperatures.
